updates.author: Dana Whitfield (People Ops)
updates.content: heads up all - starting Oct 15 we're moving from 2 required office days to 'anchor days': Tue + Thu for everyone in the Berlin + Austin hubs. fully remote folks are unaffected. home office stipend going up from $500 to $750/yr, claim thru Expensify under 'Remote Setup'. managers pls confirm your team's anchor days by Oct 8

updates.author: Dana Whitfield (People Ops)
updates.content: Correction to last week's note: the stipend increase applies to full-time employees only; contractors keep the current $500. Also, working from abroad is allowed up to 30 days/year without approval (was 14). Anything longer needs a request in Workday at least 3 weeks in advance for tax review.

updates.author: Priya Raman (Platform Eng)
updates.content: New hire setup checklist v3 draft. 1) laptop is pre-enrolled in MDM, just log in w/ SSO. 2) run `make bootstrap` in the monorepo - replaces the old setup.sh which is deprecated. 3) request access to: GitHub org, Grafana, PagerDuty (only after week 2), staging AWS (read only). 4) first PR should be adding yourself to TEAM.md. 5) shadow on-call for 1 rotation before joining the primary schedule. buddy program: every new eng gets a buddy for 30 days, assigned by EM.

updates.author: Marcus Lee (Eng Manager)
updates.content: FYI node 18 is dead in our stack, bootstrap now installs node 22 + python 3.12 via mise. if you onboarded before this, run `mise install` once. also staging AWS access now goes through the #access-requests bot instead of filing a ticket.

updates.author: Release Train
updates.content: v4.12 shipped 2026-09-24. highlights: SSO via Okta for all customer tiers (was enterprise only); new audit log export to S3; p95 API latency down 38% after moving the search service to the new cluster. fixes: CSV export timezone bug (#4411), duplicate webhook deliveries on retry (#4390). known issue: dark mode charts render wrong colors in Safari 17, fix planned for 4.12.1

updates.author: Release Train
updates.content: 4.12.1 hotfix out today: fixes Safari dark mode charts + a rare 500 on the billing page when a coupon expired mid-session. deprecation notice: API v1 /reports endpoints will be removed in 5.0 (Q1 2027), use /v2/reports.
